## Description

Send a templated message to a segment, now or scheduled. Only patients with marketing consent receive it. India promotional messages go out only 9 AM to 9 PM and use an approved DLT template; every message has an opt-out.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A patient without marketing consent is never sent a campaign (tested).
- [ ] **AC2.** A scheduled send outside 9 AM to 9 PM (India) waits until 9 AM.
- [ ] **AC3.** Opt-out takes effect before the next send and is recorded.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: the 9 AM to 9 PM rule and template placeholders. Medvya reminder consent and marketing consent stay separate.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
